grade.summary: ZOH handled the founder request well: it drafted the 100g protein target as an upgrade on Eat better, said nothing had gone to Alex, and the morning text raised it as its own idea, tied to his lunch streak, with one question. The one miss is the drafts, which said 'when it fits' or 'a natural moment' rather than naming the next morning text.
